--- lemma_split_complete  (spec/src/v2/split.rs)
pub proof fn lemma_split_complete(p: Program2, c: Cert, trusted: bool)

--- theorem_soundness_split  (spec/src/v2/split.rs)
pub proof fn theorem_soundness_split(p: Program2, g: GCert, ms: Seq<Maps>, trusted: bool,
    heap0: Seq<HeapObj>, globals0: Seq<Value>, s: State2)
    requires
        split_ok(p, g, ms, trusted),
        loaded_ok(p, with_maps(g, ms), heap0, globals0),
        reachable(p, heap0, globals0, s),
    ensures
        !(step(p, s) is Stuck),
        forall|s1: State2, module: u8, index: u16, o: Outcome2|
            step(p, s) == Outcome2::Primitive(s1, module, index) && #[trigger] completion(p, s1, module, index, o)
                ==> !(o is Stuck),
        machine_objects_ok(p, s),

--- theorem_initial  (spec/src/v2/theorem.rs)
pub proof fn theorem_initial(p: Program2, c: Cert, trusted: bool, heap0: Seq<HeapObj>, globals0: Seq<Value>)
    requires accepts(p, c, trusted), loaded_ok(p, c, heap0, globals0),
    ensures reachable(p, heap0, globals0, initial_state(p, heap0, globals0)),
        wf(p, c, initial_state(p, heap0, globals0)),

--- Machine::binary_result  (core/src/exec.rs)
pub fn binary_result(&mut self, v: usize) -> (r: Ctl)
    requires
        old(self).stack_ok(), old(self).top + 1 < old(self).lim,
        old(self).bci + 1 < usize::MAX,
    ensures
        final(self).stack_ok(),
        final(self).same_frame(old(self)),
        r == Ctl::Next,
        final(self).words() == old(self).words().subrange(0, old(self).height() - 2).push(v),
        final(self).bci == old(self).bci + 1,

--- Machine::op_load_local  (core/src/exec.rs)
pub fn op_load_local(&mut self, n: usize, len: usize) -> (r: Ctl)
    requires old(self).stack_ok(), old(self).bci + len < usize::MAX,
    ensures
        final(self).stack_ok(),
        final(self).same_frame(old(self)),
        // `spec::op_load_local`: the slot must belong to the frame.
        !(old(self).top + n < old(self).lim) ==> r == Ctl::Stuck(1),
        old(self).top + n < old(self).lim && old(self).top > old(self).ftop ==> r == Ctl::Next
            && final(self).words() == old(self).words().push(old(self).words()[old(self).height() - 1 - n])
            && final(self).bci == old(self).bci + len,

        g < old(self).globals@.len() && old(self).top < old(self).lim ==> r == Ctl::Next

        old(self).top + n <= old(self).lim ==> r == Ctl::Next

--- Machine::op_branch  (core/src/exec.rs)
pub fn op_branch(&mut self, p: &Program, kind: usize, target: usize, len: usize) -> (r: Ctl)
    requires old(self).stack_ok(), old(self).bci + len < usize::MAX,
    ensures
        final(self).stack_ok(),
        final(self).same_frame(old(self)),
        // The condition (if any) is popped.
        kind != 0 && !(old(self).top < old(self).lim) ==> r == Ctl::Stuck(1),
        kind != 0 && old(self).top < old(self).lim ==>
            final(self).words() == old(self).words().subrange(0, old(self).height() - 1),
        kind == 0 ==> final(self).words() == old(self).words(),
        ({
            let taken = kind == 0 || branch_taken(p, kind, old(self).words()[old(self).height() - 1]);
            (kind == 0 || old(self).top < old(self).lim) ==> {
                &&& !taken ==> r == Ctl::Next && final(self).bci == old(self).bci + len
                &&& taken && target_ok(p, old(self).method, target) ==> r == Ctl::Next && final(self).bci == target
                &&& taken && !target_ok(p, old(self).method, target) ==> r == Ctl::Stuck(14)
            }
        }),

--- step_verified  (spec/src/exec_step.rs)
pub fn step_verified(p: &ExecProgram, s: &mut ExecState) -> (r: Option<ExecOutcome>)
    requires wf_program(p@), wf_state(old(s)@),
    ensures
        match r {
            Some(o) => matches(step(p@, old(s)@), o, final(s)@),
            None => final(s)@ == old(s)@,
        },

--- x_class_count  (spec/src/v2/check.rs)
pub fn x_class_count(p: &VProgram) -> (r: usize)
    ensures r as int == class_count(vview(p)),

--- verify  (spec/src/v2/check.rs)
pub fn verify<O: MapOracle>(p: &VProgram, g: &XGlobal, o: &mut O, trusted: bool) -> (r: (bool, Ghost<Seq<Maps>>))
    ensures r.0 == (pins_sorted(g) && split_ok(vview(p), g@, r.1@, trusted)),

--- x_frame_height  (spec/src/v2/exec.rs)
pub fn x_frame_height(s: &ExecState) -> (r: i64)
    requires small(view2(s)), base(view2(s)) < 0x1_0000_0000_0000,
    ensures r as int == frame_height(view2(s)),

--- step_verified  (spec/src/v2/exec.rs)
pub fn step_verified(p: &ExecProgram, s: &mut ExecState) -> (r: Option<ExecOutcome2>)
    requires wf_exec_program2(p), wf_exec_state2(old(s)),
    ensures
        match r {
            Some(o) => matches2(step(pview2(p), view2(old(s))), o, view2(final(s))),
            None => view2(final(s)) == view2(old(s)),
        },

--- x_loaded_ok  (spec/src/v2/heap_check.rs)
pub fn x_loaded_ok(p: &VProgram, global_count: u64, heap: &Vec<ExecObj>, globals: &Vec<Value>) -> (r: bool)
    requires wf_program2(vview(p)),
    ensures forall|c: Cert| c.global_count == global_count as int ==> r == #[trigger] loaded_ok(vview(p), c, hview(heap), globals@),

--- vmethods_of  (spec/src/v2/vprog.rs)
pub fn vmethods_of(e: &ExecProgram, h: u16) -> (r: Option<Vec<VMethod>>)
    ensures
        r is Some ==> r->0@.len() == e.methods@.len()
            && forall|i: int| 0 <= i < e.methods@.len() ==> #[trigger] minfo(r->0@[i], h) == e.methods@[i],

--- vprogram_of  (spec/src/v2/vprog.rs)
pub fn vprogram_of<'a>(e: &'a ExecProgram, methods: &'a Vec<VMethod>, h: u16) -> (r: VProgram<'a>)
    requires
        methods@.len() == e.methods@.len(),
        forall|i: int| 0 <= i < e.methods@.len() ==> #[trigger] minfo(methods@[i], h) == e.methods@[i],
    ensures vview(&r) == pview2(e),
